items.t: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
items.d: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
items.fullText: Microsoft generated $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ended September 30, the company said in a regulatory filing on Wednesday. That represents nearly 11% of Microsoft’s total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion, highlighting the enormous financial ties that remain between the two companies even as they increasingly compete for the same customers . (Microsoft’s financial year begins in July, making the quarter ended September 30, 2026 the first quarter of its fiscal 2027.) For the full 2026 fiscal year, revenue from OpenAI hit $24.1 billion. At its latest quarterly pace, Microsoft would pull in $40 billion annually from OpenAI-related arrangements. Microsoft also reported $7.2 billion in outstanding receivables from OpenAI at the end of September, up from $6 billion at the end of June. That money represents amounts OpenAI owes for previous transactions, not additional revenue. It’s not clear how much of Microsoft’s revenue from OpenAI came from revenue-sharing payments or Azure cloud computing services. TechCrunch has reached out for more information. In November 2025, TechCrunch reported , citing leaked documents, that Microsoft had received $865.8 million in net revenue-sharing payments from OpenAI during the first nine months of that year. OpenAI reportedly shares 20% of its revenue with Microsoft as part of a previous deal in which the software giant invested more than $13 billion in the AI startup. (Neither the AI lab nor Microsoft have publicly confirmed this percentage.) As part of an April 2026 agreement, OpenAI is on the hook to continue sharing revenue with Microsoft through 2030, subject to a cap, even as OpenAI is allowed to work with competing cloud providers. The companies began loosening the ties of their once-exclusive partnership in October 2025, when Microsoft relinquished its hold on OpenAI to give the startup more freedom to partner with other cloud providers. items.t: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
items.d: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
items.fullText: The financials Anthropic shared with investors this week suggest that its AI coding tool, Claude Code, is every bit the business success the frontier lab wanted. The company recorded an operating profit in the second quarter, and 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026. Anthropic has focused on getting enterprise users to stick around and Wednesday announced a new suite of reporting tools designed to give those customers a more granular understanding of the value they get from their token spend. Using internal analytics and employee surveys, managers can view a team’s work over a given date range, what the team produced, how much it cost, and where its workflows broke down. Anthropic says it won’t use this data for model training by default. The reports will also offer recommendations on how to improve the results. Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers. Anthropic is also creating pooled group budgets to allow teams to better manage token spending. Businesses have been hunting for that kind of information as they figure out how best to deploy AI tools. While usage among venture-backed firms is driving token spend, most of the Fortune 500 are not seeing major gains from deploying AI. Jellyfish, a company that makes tools for software developers, released a new report yesterday based on the use of agentic coding tools by 276,000 of its customers. Claude Code and other tools built on Anthropic models remain the most widely used in the survey, responsible for nearly a third of all proposed code changes submitted for review. items.t: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.d: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
items.fullText: Google is making it easier for businesses to connect their apps to its AI experiences across Search and Gemini with the debut of its Connected Apps Platform. Introduced in Gemini and Google Search earlier this year, connected apps let users securely link and interact with popular third-party services, then use them to take specific actions. For instance, you could connect to Canva to design a flyer, or to YouTube Music to build a playlist. We’ve seen varying takes on the idea by other consumer-facing AI services like ChatGPT and Meta’s Muse. The premise is that such integrations could ultimately shift consumer behavior away from launching and using individual apps to instead using their favorite services through their preferred AI provider. However, to successfully capture and retain consumers’ attention, there have to actually be a wide range of connected apps to explore. Google’s idea is to open its doors to any business or developer that wants to reach users through Search or Gemini by allowing them to submit their own connected apps and monitor their performance. The platform preview is currently available in beta to developers in the U.S., and will allow developers to build and submit apps that can be used across Google’s products. To get started, developers would integrate with a cloud-hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server or Android MCP using the AppFunctions APIs, then use the Google Connected Console to register, test, and submit their app, Google explains. Essentially, this process lets devs connect their app to Google’s services so it can be used with the search giant’s AI features. Developers can also choose whether they want their app to be available via Search, the Gemini app, or both. After the app is live, developers can track traffic, latency, and error rates, and maintain control over their brand identity, such as their verified logos and authenticated accounts. items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 ETRI '한국어 AI튜터', GPT보다 더 똑똑하네 입력 2026.10.28 17:33 수정 2026.10.29 01:36 지면 A12 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 이영애 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 한국전자통신연구원(ETRI)은 외국인 학습자가 자유롭게 대화하면서도 정해진 진도를 따라갈 수 있는 한국어 교육용 인공지능(AI) 챗봇 ‘한국어 AI 선생님’을 개발했다고 28일 밝혔다. 챗봇은 AI가 학습자의 대화 흐름에 맞춰 학습 단계를 관리한다. AI가 학습자에게 대화 주제를 제시하고 흐름을 파악해 자연스럽게 다음 학습 단계로 이끈다. 여기에는 ETRI가 자체 개발한 30억~130억 개 매개변수 규모의 소형언어모델(SLM)과 범용 AI가 함께 사용된다. 대화 진행 상황에 따라 학습 단계를 조정하고 이미 나온 질문을 반복하지 않도록 하는 기능도 적용했다. 지난해 말 외부 기관이 외국인 학습자와 한국어 교사 등 102명을 대상으로 진행한 블라인드 평가에서 ETRI 기술의 응답 적절성은 93.8%로, GPT-4o-미니(91.0%)와 GPT-5.1(90.9%)보다 높았다. 대화 오류율도 18.6%로 두 모델(25.4%·23.7%)보다 좋았다. ETRI는 말하기뿐 아니라 읽기와 쓰기까지 지원하는 AI 튜터로 기술을 확대하고 있다. 스마트 글라스와 연계해 음성만으로 한국어를 학습하는 플랫폼도 개발 중이다. 이영애 기자 0ae@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이영애 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 "AI 모르면 끝장"…CEO들, 대학으로 모인다 한국경제신문의 투자 전문 유료 플랫폼 '한경 프리미엄9'(www.hankyung.com/premium9)에 실린 기사입니다. items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 "챗GPT부터 국산 AI까지 골라 쓴다"…KT 'AI 플랫폼' 승부수 입력 2026.10.27 16:06 수정 2026.10.27 16:10 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 라현진 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 오픈라우터와 손잡고 AI 모델 500개 연결 국내 GPU로 7종 직접 구동 모델 자동 선택·보안·과금 통합 토큰 비용 최대 25% 절감 박윤영 대표 'AX 플랫폼 컴퍼니' 전략 구체화 박상원 KT AX사업부문장이 27일 서울 세종로 KT광화문빌딩에서 열린 기자간담회에서 '토큰팩토리' 사업에 대해 발표하고 있다. /사진=KT 제공 KT가 500개 이상의 인공지능(AI) 모델을 한곳에서 이용할 수 있는 플랫폼을 선보인다. 통신사업에서 쌓은 연결·과금·보안 역량을 앞세워 AI 플랫폼 시장을 선점하겠다는 목표다. 박윤영 KT 대표가 취임 후 내놓은 ‘AX 플랫폼 컴퍼니’ 전략이 구체화된 첫 번째 결과다. 업무별로 최적 AI 자동 선택 KT는 27일 서울 세종로 KT광화문빌딩에서 기자간담회를 열고 AI 플랫폼 ‘토큰팩토리’를 공개했다. 토큰팩토리는 하나의 응용프로그램인터페이스(API)로 국내외 AI 모델을 통합 제공하는 플랫폼이다. 이용자는 여러 AI 서비스를 개별적으로 구독할 필요 없이 하나의 플랫폼에서 모델 선택부터 사용량 확인, 비용 관리, 결제까지 처리할 수 있다. 오는 30일 기업 고객을 대상으로 정식 출시한다. 첫 출시 때는 73개 AI 모델을 제공하고 오는 12월에는 글로벌 AI 모델 중개 플랫폼 오픈라우터와 연계해 500개 이상으로 늘린다. 내년 3월에는 개인 개발자와 일반 이용자에게도 서비스를 제공할 계획이다. 핵심은 업무에 적합한 모델을 자동으로 골라 요청을 보내는 ‘모델 라우팅’이다. KT가 자체 개발한 ‘오토 모델 라우터’는 질문의 난이도와 요구 품질, 비용을 분석한다. 간단한 요약·번역에는 경량 모델을, 복잡한 추론에는 고성능 모델을 배정하는 방식이다. 입력 문장에서 불필요한 표현을 제거하는 압축 기술도 적용했다. KT에 따르면 프롬프트 압축으로 약 20%, 모델 자동 선택으로 약 5%의 비용 절감 효과를 낸다. 예컨대 ‘다음 주 출장인데 월요일 오전에 서울에서 부산으로 가는 KTX 열차를 찾아줘’라는 질문을 ‘다음 주 월요일 오전 서울 부산 KTX’로 압축하는 식이다. 질문의 의미를 유지하면서 AI가 처리해야 할 토큰 수를 줄여 비용과 응답 시간을 단축한다는 설명이다. 이진형 KT AX사업본부장이 27일 서울 세종로 KT광화문빌딩에서 열린 기자간담회에서 '토큰팩토리' 사업에 대해 발표하고 있다. /사진=KT 제공 토큰팩토리만의 차별점은 국내에서 AI 추론을 직접 수행한다는 것이다. AI 모델 7개는 국내 KT 데이터센터에서 구동된다. 업스테이지 ‘솔라 프로4’, KT ‘믿음 K3.0’, 모티프 ‘모티프3’ 등 국산 모델 3종과 지푸AI의 ‘GLM-5.3-플래시’, 구글 ‘젬마4-31B’ 등 해외 오픈웨이트 모델 4종이다. 오픈웨이트는 모델의 가중치가 공개돼 자체 인프라에서 구동할 수 있는 방식이다. 이진형 KT AX사업본부장은 “해외 모델 제공사와 별도 계약을 맺고 국내 데이터센터에서 직접 추론 서비스를 제공하기로 했다”며 “데이터 처리를 국내에서 수행하는 소버린 AI 환경을 구현하는 데 의미가 있다”고 말했다. 연내 오픈라우터를 입점시켜 글로벌 AI 모델 500개 이상을 확보할 예정이다. 이에 따라 국산 모델, 오픈웨이트

items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Anthropic reveals $80 billion loss, huge spending spree ahead of IPO The company warned that AI could “pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity” as cybersecurity fears grow. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time 03:17 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 26, 2026, 9:12 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 26, 2026, 11:16 AM EDT By Steve Kopack Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic on Monday unveiled its public IPO filing ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. That offering, widely expected to come sometime in mid-November, could value the Claude developer at more than $2 trillion. That could surpass the current record holder, Elon Musk’s SpaceX, which raised $75 billion in an IPO in June that valued the rocket-AI-social-media firm at $2.1 trillion. The filing did not include a potential share price, the number of shares to be offered or a valuation for the whole company, all of which will be determined after Anthropic holds a “road show” with investors, prospective investors and its bankers. Monday’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission showed that Anthropic, like other AI firms, is splashing out unprecedented amounts of cash on cloud services to run its AI models. The company plans to spend at least $110 billion with Amazon for cloud services through April 2036 and another $120 billion with SpaceX through 2029. Anthropic also said it planned to spend $115 billion with Google and $45 billion with Microsoft, both through 2033, for computing infrastructure. The filing said that the company recorded revenue growth of “1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, 2026.” The cost of renting servers and chips grew by 300% over the same period. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Elvis Presley’s rights holders sue Anthropic, saying it trained AI on his music Anthropic has said it “disagree[s] with the claims and intend[s] to defend this case fully.” Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Elvis Presley performs in 1955. Michael Ochs Archives / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 25, 2026, 3:11 PM EDT By Angela Yang and Austin Mullen The owners of Elvis Presley’s music have sued Anthropic, alleging it used his copyrighted lyrics without permission to train its AI models and generating infringing versions of his songs. In a lawsuit filed Friday, Authentic Brands Group, the licensing platform that controls Presley’s intellectual property — along with other companies, trusts and individuals who own rights to his music — accused Anthropic of infringing copyrights to 274 songs without any license or payment. These span some of Presley’s biggest hits, including “All Shook Up,” “Can’t Help Falling in Love,” “Don’t Be Cruel,” “A Little Less Conversation” and “Return to Sender.” “The Elvis Plaintiffs’ iconic collective catalog contains some of the most groundbreaking, revolutionary, influential, and enduring musical compositions in human history,” the lawsuit stated. The plaintiffs allege that the infringement has occurred throughout “the entire development” of Anthropic’s flagship Claude models and continues today as users generate outputs that reproduce copyrighted lyrics or create unauthorized adaptations of the songs. “As we say in the lawsuit, the Elvis Plaintiffs are guardians of, and highly protective of, Elvis’s song which are some of the most iconic of all time,” attorney Richard Busch wrote in a statement. A spokesperson for Anthropic wrote: “We disagree with the claims and intend to defend this case fully.” Elvis Presley performs circa 1975. items.fullText: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations October 21, 2026 by Mavi Nafria 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. items.fullText: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents Growing ecosystem of AI clouds across Europe, Nordics, Africa and Central Asia build full-stack NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factories as AI-native companies drive demand for sovereign compute, training, inference and post-training services. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements.
